transcript: Speaker A: Namaskar, eh hai hun tak di sab ton vaddi khabar! Ikk navi app aayi hai jo Punjabi bolan waleyan nu Punjabi vich hi English sikhaundi hai. App da naam hai MySivi. Is app vich tuhanu ek AI teacher milda hai, jisde naal tusi roz English bolan di practice kar sakde ho. Kai users ne dassya hai ki sirf 10 ton 15 minutes roz practice karan naal ohna di English bahut sudhar gayi hai. Oh dhyan naal suno eh gal. Isda sab ton vadda kaaran eh hai ki ithe sab kuch saukhi Punjabi vich samjhaya janda hai. Jo lok jaldi English bolni sikhna chaunde ne, ohna layi MySivi app ikk aasaan solution hai. Hun koi vi MySivi app download kar sakda hai, ate sirf 1 rupee vich English sikhni start kar sakda hai. [Hello, this is the biggest news so far! A new app has arrived that teaches English to Punjabi speakers in Punjabi itself. The app's name is MySivi. In this app, you get an AI teacher with whom you can practice speaking English daily. Many users have said that practicing just 10 to 15 minutes daily has greatly improved their English. Listen to this carefully. The biggest reason for this is that everything is explained in simple Punjabi here. For those who want to learn to speak English quickly, the MySivi app is an easy solution. Now anyone can download the MySivi app and start learning English for just 1 rupee.] Speaker B: Install Now button te click karke hune MySivi download karo. [Click on the Install Now button and download MySivi now.]
on_screen_text: NAMASKAR, DI SAB TON VADDI KHABAR! IKK NAVI APP AAYI HAI MySivi APP DA NAAM HAI MYSIVI. IS APP VICH TUHANU MILDA HAI, JISDE NAAL TUSI ROZ ENGLISH BOLAN SAKDE HO. KAI USERS NE DASSYA HAI KI SIRF 10 TON 15 MINUTES ROZ PRACTICE KARAN NAAL OHNA DI ENGLISH BAHUT SUDHAR GAYI HAI. OH DHYAN NAAL SUNO EH GAL. ISDA SAB TON VADDA KAARAN EH HAI KI ITHE SAB KUCH SAUKHI PUNJABI VICH SAMJHAAYA JAANDA HAI. JO LOK JALDI ENGLISH BOLNI SIKHNA CHAUNDE NE, OHNA LAYI MYSIVI APP IKK AASAAN SOLUTION HAI. HUN KOI VI MYSIVI APP DOWNLOAD KAR SAKDA HAI, ATE SIRF 1 RUPEYE VICH ENGLISH SIKHNI START KAR SAKDA HAI. MySivi Premium, 3 days of Premium for ’1. MySivi English speaking app, Install Now.
summary: An AI news anchor introduces MySivi, an app that teaches English to Punjabi speakers using simple Punjabi explanations and an AI tutor. The ad highlights quick daily practice benefits and offers a 3-day premium trial for 1 rupee, urging users to download the app.
